verdict.rationale: Jira now markets coding-agent assignment, development-status views and Rovo AI, so AI explanation of code changes is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows Jira itself breaking a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why. Rovo's documented features (task breakdown, automations, trend spotting) and the Bitbucket integration are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
